item.text: {"brief_complete":false,"completion_reason":"Material validation and rollout decisions remain unresolved.","questions":[{"decision_key":"sensitive_evidence_retention","label":"Evidence safety","context":"Runs are immutable, but evidence may contain secrets or sensitive data.","question":"How should sensitive run evidence be stored?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Redact before immutable persistence; reject evidence that cannot be safely redacted."},{"number":2,"text":"Encrypt raw evidence and expose only a redacted view."},{"number":3,"text":"Store raw evidence permanently with access controls."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":93},{"decision_key":"canonical_crash_consistency","label":"Crash consistency","context":"Canonical context, checkpoints, and artifacts must remain crash-safe.","question":"What consistency guarantee should a committed checkpoint provide?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Atomically commit context, checkpoint, and artifact references together."},{"number":2,"text":"Commit independently and reconcile incomplete records after restart."},{"number":3,"text":"Allow partial commits but require manual recovery."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":91},{"decision_key":"legacy_data_rollout","label":"Legacy rollout","context":"Streamlining may change schemas while existing product data must remain safe.","question":"How should existing runs and conversations be handled at rollout?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Keep legacy data read-only and migrate lazily with rollback."},{"number":2,"text":"Perform a one-time in-place migration before launch."},{"number":3,"text":"Start clean and provide a legacy export only."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":82}]}
